questions.question: How do you test whether a line is a line of symmetry?
questions.expected_answer: Fold the shape along the line, or stand a mirror on it. If the two halves match exactly, the line is a line of symmetry.

questions.question: Why are the diagonals of a rectangle that is not a square not lines of symmetry?
questions.expected_answer: If you fold the rectangle along a diagonal, the two halves do not land on top of each other, because the corners stick out. So the halves do not match.

questions.question: How many lines of symmetry do a square, a regular hexagon and a parallelogram that is not a rectangle have?
questions.expected_answer: A square has 4, a regular hexagon has 6, and the parallelogram has none.
